answer: Each challenge is instantiated from a domain-separated hash of the claimant’s commitment and a future drand beacon pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature is unpredictable before publication. Responses are bound to that pulse and task, so cached answers and offline-generated task banks cannot be prepared in advance or reused across identities. Like an ocean plume shifted by a new current, each pulse changes the challenge, raising the cost of automated sybil farming without eliminating identities.
